description:
Running 'pre-commit run' on any touched files fails regardless of the change:
- markdownlint: MD013 (80-col line length) fires on existing docs (e.g. 21 hits in AGENTS.md) and on the reflowed-prose style the repo uses; mdformat (treefmt) keeps long lines, so the two hooks disagree.
- statix: reports pre-existing warnings in unrelated files (jjui.nix, kew.nix, yt-dlp.nix, ssh.nix, jujutsu.nix, television.nix, herdr.nix, tuicr.nix, settings/manual/manpages.nix).
Either fix the warnings and configure MD013 to match the repo's prose style, or the hooks are noise that hide real failures. Found while adding home-modules/claude-context.md.
title: pre-commit markdownlint and statix hooks fail on pre-existing files
